uncertainty.frame_unit: sample_id, paired across candidates within profile
uncertainty.scenario_unit: experiment_id x inferred one-of-eight trajectory loop, paired across candidates within profile

selection_rule: Use validation only for candidate selection.
A candidate is eligible only when every normal_gate profile passes every absolute normal-service floor.
Eligibility also requires material pooled-normal precision/FP improvement under both paired frame and paired scenario bootstrap.
Select world_suppression_1m when eligible; consider world_suppression_2m only when 1m is ineligible and 2m is eligible.
Freeze at most one selected setting; evaluate baseline and that setting once on the untouched original test identifiers.

Test is confirmatory: promotion-review readiness requires every normal profile to pass every floor and paired material precision/FP improvement to retain the validation direction. No test-driven reselection is allowed.

no_retraining_decision_rule.CONSERVATIVE_POSTPROCESSING_READY_FOR_PR: A validation-selected 1m or 2m setting is eligible and the one-shot test confirmation passes; this is not deployment approval.
no_retraining_decision_rule.RETRAINING_PILOT_JUSTIFIED: Neither conservative candidate is validation-eligible despite complete valid inference/provenance, or the frozen setting fails confirmatory test floors/evidence; propose but do not start an AE64 pilot.
no_retraining_decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Required dataset identity, disjointness, provenance, representative predictions, paired uncertainty, or GPU/list latency evidence is missing or invalid.

latency.gpu_decoder_definition: CUDA-synchronized elapsed time from decoded split feature tensors through GPU decode_outputs, predicted-list decode_objects, and the 40m prediction range gate
latency.incremental_list_definition: CPU perf_counter_ns time for greedy score-ordered class-aware predicted-world suppression on the already-retained list
